# JetThoughts

> Senior engineers for funded startups. A Sprint first. Embedded after, if you want us to stay. JetThoughts has been building software since 2008 and is rated 4.8/5 on Clutch (https://clutch.co/profile/jetthoughts).

Contact: sales@jetthoughts.com

## Services

- [Services](https://jetthoughts.com/services/): Two ways to hire senior engineers: a two-week Sprint that ships one feature, or Embedded engineers who stay for years.
- [Sprint](https://jetthoughts.com/services/sprint/): One feature live for your users in two weeks. Scope and price are agreed before any work starts.
- [Embedded](https://jetthoughts.com/services/embedded/): Engineers who stay for years. The average JetThoughts client relationship is five years.
- [Performance](https://jetthoughts.com/services/performance/): A two-week Sprint that times the requests users wait on in a Rails app, fixes the slowest ones and shows the numbers before and after.
- [AI features](https://jetthoughts.com/services/ai-features/): A Sprint that adds an AI feature to your product. Our proof is elital, our own AI product; no client LLM feature has shipped yet.
- [Code audit](https://jetthoughts.com/services/vibe-code-audit/): A fixed-price, read-only audit of an AI-built Next.js and Supabase app. A written report says what is wrong, how serious each finding is, and what each fix costs.
- [For agencies](https://jetthoughts.com/partners/): Engineers for builds an agency has already sold.

## Work

- [Clients](https://jetthoughts.com/clients/): Six clients: what changed for each, and how long we worked together.
- [elital](https://jetthoughts.com/clients/elital/): Our own AI product: candidate matching with vector search, a 0-100 match score and an LLM-written reason.
- [Open source](https://github.com/jetthoughts): Our gems and repositories on GitHub.
